messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: How to fit an unfolding model in Lavaan?
parts:
Carol

I am not familiar with these models.

With binary items lavaan ill estimate a factor model that is equivalent to the 2PL model, and with ordinal items lavaan will estimate a model equivalent to the Graded Response Model. The main difference is that lavaan models use the probit link function instead of the logit link function

It might be possible to add constraints to make the model equivalent this unfolding model, but I cant assure that


-- Mauricio
